src/main.cpp 
#include <MiniServer.h>

auto *Server = new EspWeb::MiniServer();

Server->dns("myESP32");
Server->use(Server->cors());

Server->get("/hello", [](Request &req,
                       Response &res) {
    res.text("Hello from ESP32!").OK();
});

Server->start(80);
✔ WiFi connected · 192.168.178.85
✔ http://myESP32.local listening on :80
